5217c334563a5e2935634769668c8a65.overview: In the midst of a marital crisis, a High Court judge must decide if she should order a life-saving blood transfusion for a teen with cancer despite his family's refusal to accept medical treatment for religious reasons.
5217c334563a5e2935634769668c8a65.tagline: We all make choices. Hers make history.

524bf200ad5ef5c559c96f16eb9cc261.overview: A home, a motorcar, servants, the latest fashions: the most eligible and most finicky bachelor in Paris offers them all to Gigi. But she, who's gone from girlish gawkishness to cultured glamour before our eyes, yearns for that wonderful something money can't buy.

526eb3d3ff2f55bd05f9bf869e996569.overview: A Salem resident attempts to frame her ex-lover's wife for being a witch in the middle of the 1692 witchcraft trials.
526eb3d3ff2f55bd05f9bf869e996569.tagline: Arthur Miller's timeless tale of truth on trial.

5298d524ca95b1a534e2adb01ba8ed33.overview: Two youngsters from rival New York City gangs fall in love, but tensions between their respective friends build toward tragedy.
5298d524ca95b1a534e2adb01ba8ed33.tagline: A city divided. Their love will challenge everything.

52ad274931f40c4cd6575bb3bae0b35d.overview: Eager to find a better life abroad, a Senegalese woman becomes a mere governess to a family in southern France, suffering from discrimination and marginalization.

52babc12ebbe39d3e5757000bec5424f.overview: A recently widowed American begins an anonymous sexual relationship with a young Parisian woman.
52babc12ebbe39d3e5757000bec5424f.tagline: When you see a love story, it's only a movie. When you feel it with every nerve in your body, it's a masterpiece.

52e9ee3ecd5d65bfc034f79d950e8533.overview: An American doctor gets caught in the middle of a revolution when he's forced to operate on a South American dictator.
52e9ee3ecd5d65bfc034f79d950e8533.tagline: Carefree Cary Grant on a gay holiday with his lovely bride walks right into DANGER!
